description: KTX2-only textures, as KTX-Software 4.4 encodes them: ETC1S color, ETC1S with an alpha gradient, and a UASTC normal map (zstd), 64×64 each. The color and normal images are sampled in their top-left quarter only.

ktx2.why: ETC1S is BasisLZ-supercompressed; UASTC has vkFormat 0 and colorModel 166. Only alpha.ktx2 has an alpha slice, a gradient from 0 at the left to 255 at the right. The quarter-sampled images, with linear filtering and REPEAT wrapping, reach 34 texels a side: 0 to 32, and 63 across the wrap. Decoded, each image is close to the PNG it was encoded from: the four quadrants of the test pattern, or a smooth normal map pointing outwards from the center.
